issues.detail: The Hebrew 'מַטּוֹת אֲבֹתָם' means 'the tribes of their fathers' (i.e., ancestral tribes), but the Chinese renders it as '父的名' (the name of the father) and '那杖' (that staff/rod), which misinterprets 'מַטּוֹת' (tribes) as 'name' and 'staff/rod'. This changes the meaning from inheriting by ancestral tribes to inheriting by a father's name and a staff.
